title: Polar form, powers and roots of complex numbers
summary: Convert complex numbers to polar form with atan2, raise them to powers with de Moivre's formula, and find all n-th roots and the roots of unity.

mutants.arctan_ratio: Uses arctan of the ratio y / x, which loses the quadrant and divides by zero for x = 0.
mutants.manhattan_radius: Uses |x| + |y| and not the Euclidean length for the radius.
mutants.power_adds_exponent: Adds n to the angle and does not multiply the angle by n.
mutants.root_angle_not_divided: Divides only theta by n and not the added turns 2 pi k.
